description: Adversarial review of the li-w6mvog aggregate-check gate found that scripts/check.ts and scripts/package-scripts.test.ts verify exact dependency pins with the unanchored regex /^\d+\.\d+\.\d+/, which accepts range specs that merely START with an exact version, e.g. `1.2.3 || 2.0.0` or `1.2.3 - 2.0.0`. Tighten both to require the entire spec to be an exact version (/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:[-+][0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/, allowing prerelease/build metadata) and add fixtures proving `1.2.3 || 2.0.0`, `^1.2.3`, `~1.2.3`, and `latest` fail the check.
title: Exact-pin dependency gate accepts range strings starting with a version
